entries.label: Adequate Sized, Actually
cells: All Tiny Cogs you get have a 50% chance be 1 Tier higher than they otherwise would've been! Huge, honestly!

entries.label: All Night Studying
cells: Boosts Research EXP gain by +50%. You'll be filling out this Grid in no time at all!

entries.label: All Quick All Done
cells: Every day, the first 'All Quick' use at the MSA in World 3 gives 1.5x more Souls and EXP!

entries.label: Better Button
cells: All button bonuses are +5% bigger, which is ballin' since all button upgrades sans Class EXP are multiplicative!

entries.label: Boony Crowns
cells: For every King Rat Crown you reclaim, all your stickers gives 1% higher bonuses.

entries.label: Cellular Warfare
cells: Multiplies all damage dealt by your cells during operations by 1.05x. A true operator must consider the indirect bloodcell gain...

entries.label: Daily Operating Procedure
cells: Gives you +1 more operations to start every day at the Jelly Operator game!

entries.label: Day 'N' Nite
cells: Increases the Max LV of all Day and Night Market upgrades by +50

entries.label: Depth Charge Rematch!
cells: Gives you +1 more tries every day at Mr Minehead's Depth Charge! Also, +25% Minehead Currency/hr

entries.label: Divine Design
cells: You are now permanently linked to Arctis on all characters. Also, +25% Drop Rate.

entries.label: Eclectic Sigils
cells: Sigils can be upgraded a 5th time to Eclectic! NOTE:You must defeat Lore Boss 7 in Spelunking first!

entries.label: Eclectoplasmaticism
cells: What kind of word is Eclectopl... whatever, this gives you +1% TRUE DMG Multi per Eclectic Sigil!

entries.label: Equinox Nightmares
cells: Unlocks new dreams to complete at the Equinox Valley in World 3! Also boosts Equinox Bar Fill Rate by 1.2x

entries.label: Game Design 101
cells: Psst... you forgot to give Observation LV a purpose while helping Lava research new content! How about you do... Observations give 1.04x more EXP per LV!

entries.label: Game Design 102
cells: Design problem, why would players level up old Observations? How about... +1% Research EXP per TOTAL Observation LV!

entries.label: Gaming Zuperbits
cells: Unlocks the Zuperbits page of Superbits in Gaming! Yea, you ain't done with those just yet! Also gives 3x Gaming Bit Multi!

entries.label: Glimbo BOGO Offer
cells: Some of Glimbo's trades give +1 additional LVs! This works retroactively. Also, 1.1x Coin gain

entries.label: Glimbo Insider Trading Secrets
cells: +1% Drop Rate TRUE Multi per 100 Glimbo Trades!

entries.label: Glimbo Linguistics
cells: You can now speak to Glimbo, and make trades with him! Also boosts coins dropped by monsters by 1.15x!

entries.label: Holding Onto You
cells: Twists the Kaleidoscope behind both of your eyes, increasing their effect by +10%

entries.label: Insta Skips
cells: Every week, you get +1 Insta uses for The Button on the Mantaray map, which let you skip the current demand. Also, +3% chance for +1 use every day

entries.label: Jelly Operator Linguistics
cells: You can now speak to the Jelly found in the Jellofish map to play the Jelly Operator game! Also, 1.1x more Bloodcells gained from operations!

entries.label: Kaleidoscope
cells: Gives +1 Kaleidoscopes to use for Observations! Also, +5% Kaleidoscope effect!

entries.label: Legendary Brown Fever
cells: Raises the Max LV of certain Brown Legend Talents by +1. Also, 1.05x Class EXP gain!

entries.label: Legendary Green Fever
cells: Raises the Max LV of certain Green Legend Talents by +1. Also, 1.05x Class EXP gain!

entries.label: Legendary Red Fever
cells: Raises the Max LV of certain Red Legend Talents by +1. Also, 1.05x Class EXP gain!

entries.label: Legendary Yellow Fever
cells: Raises the Max LV of certain Yellow Legend Talents by +1. Also, 1.05x Class EXP gain!

entries.label: Lil' Baby Menagerie
cells: Adds a baby menagerie jellyfish here in town for quick access to the Luminous Menagerie! Also boosts hourly Lumi Gains by 1.05x

entries.label: Masterclass Research
cells: Reduces the cost of all OG Masterclass upgrades (DB, WW, AC) by 10% every day, FOREVER!

entries.label: Masterius Cookerius
cells: Multiplies your EXP gain for Cooking Mastery, a feature unlocked at Rift 61, by a massive 1.75x. Also gives +1 Yellow PTS to spend on Meals!

entries.label: Materials Science
cells: Reduces the Cycle Time for the Polymerization tab in the Refinery by 25%

entries.label: Menagerie Missionary
cells: Unlocks +1 more Missions for the Luminous Menagerie, so you can claim more shells and rank up! Also, +8% hourly Lumi Gains

entries.label: Minehead Copium
cells: If your 1st click is on a depth charge, 50% chance it wiggles and doesn't count! Happens up to 1 times per game. Also, +15% Minehead Currency gain!

entries.label: Minehead Damagio
cells: Multiplies all damage you deal in Mr Minehead's Depth Charge by 1.15x

entries.label: More of that Minehead Money Pls
cells: Multiplies Minehead Currency/hr by 1.25x

entries.label: Mr Minehead Linguistics
cells: You can now speak to Mr Minehead and play his Depth Charge game! Also, +10 base Minehead Currency/hr

entries.label: Observationalistic
cells: Gives you +1 more Daily Rolls for getting new Observations! Also, +1% Research EXP gain!

entries.label: Optical Monocle
cells: Gives +1 Optical Monocles to use for Observations! Also +1% Insight EXP gain, to level up your Observations faster with!

entries.label: Oracular Spectacular
cells: Taking only what you need from it, your Optical Monocles generate +25% more Insight!

entries.label: Palettable Crowns
cells: +3% Palette Luck for every King Rat Crown you reclaim.

entries.label: Polymer Refinery
cells: Unlocks a new tab in the Refinery, POLYMERIZATION! Also, +5% faster refinery cycles for ALL tabs!

entries.label: Powered Down Research
cells: Further increases your Research AFK Gains rate by +1%, in your unending quest for 100%

entries.label: Pts Every Ten
cells: Get +1 extra Research PTS every 10 Research LVs! Also, +5% Research EXP Gain!

entries.label: Rat King of Olde
cells: You can now buy the Rat King from the Import Shop in Gaming! Also, +25% King Tokens per hour!

entries.label: Research AFK Gains
cells: +5% Research AFK Gains. This affects OFFLINE gains for Research, Minehead, Insight... everything Research related!

entries.label: Revival of the Undead Battalion
cells: Your Sailing Boats turn into the Undead Battalion at LV 400+ These boats find 3x more Treasure, are 3x faster, and have 3x higher Artifact Find Chance!

entries.label: Risky Strategy
cells: Your Minehead Damage is boosted by +10% for every tile revealed in a single turn. This resets at the start of every turn.

entries.label: Royal Rewards
cells: Regal Mobs now have a 10% chance to give +3 kills for your Royal Guardian's Orb of Virisimilitude instead of simply +2 kills

entries.label: See 'Em All
cells: +5% Research EXP gain per Observation found!

entries.label: Shakin' It
cells: Every day, you get another +1 extra uses for ALL your shakers at the Sushi Station! And +1% chance for free use when using Shakers!

entries.label: Sharp Eye
cells: Increase the max possible Roll while searching for new observations by +1, and +5% Research EXP gain!

entries.label: Smart Eye
cells: Raises the minimum possible Roll by +1 for each failed Roll, up to +25. This resets back to 0 upon a successful Roll. Also +5% Research EXP Gain.

entries.label: Spelunking Research
cells: Boosts Spelunking POW by +25% every day, FOREVER!

entries.label: Sticker Depot
cells: Unlocks the Sticker mechanic for Farming! Also, boosts Megacrop growth chance by 1.5x

entries.label: Sticker-it To Em!
cells: Unlocks a new TRUE Damage Multiplier as shown in the Sticker Depot, which goes up by +1% for every Sticker you find!

entries.label: Stickery Crowns
cells: For every King Rat Crown you reclaim, your Megacrop growth chance goes up by 25%.

entries.label: Sushi Station Linguistics
cells: You can now speak to the knife found in the map past Glimbo to play the Sushi Station game! Also, 1.25x more Bucks gained from your Sushi!

entries.label: Takin' Notes
cells: Multiplies Research EXP gain by 1.12x, TRUE multiplier style! So this bonus will never be additive!

entries.label: The Maw
cells: Unlocks a new island in Sailing, THE MAW! Also, 1.25x Artifact Find Chance. You'll need it.

entries.label: Tiny Cogs
cells: Unlocks the Tiny Cog board, and generates a single Tiny Cog per day! Also boosts Flaggy Rate by 3x

entries.label: Transcendent Artifacts
cells: Unlocks Transcendent Sailing Artifacts tier, and boosts Artifact Find Chance by a smol +25%

entries.label: Well Dressed
cells: The first MISC Bonus on your Attire Equipment (i.e. Clothing) gives 1.25x more bonus!

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 62 research grid squares in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
